text:
alex_sales: Quick sync — AcmeCorp POC kicked off. They want SSO (Okta/SAML) + SCIM for user provisioning, RBAC role mapping, and domain controls for tenant verification. Need pricing clarity for Dedicated capacity during POC.

maria_se: Got it. Can you share the POC acceptance criteria? We should confirm test users, expected TPS, and whether they'll do bulk SCIM import.

alex_sales: Rachel (Acme) sent requirements: 1) primary idp = Okta SAML; 2) SCIM for automated provisioning (50k users initial bulk, then daily delta); 3) RBAC with Okta groups -> app roles mapping; 4) domain ownership for inbound webhook validation and email-based tenant proofing. Also they asked about Dedicated burst pricing for 2 weeks.

maria_se: 50k initial -> big but doable. We need to flag SCIM throttling and delta sync strategy. Our recommended approach: initial bulk via signed S3 CSV import + SCIM deltas for changes. That avoids 50k immediate SCIM calls.

sam_security: Two security blockers from questionnaire: 1) confirmation of assertion encryption for SAML? We support encrypted assertions (RSA-OAEP / AES-GCM) — need SP metadata. 2) SCIM needs to be over mTLS or client-cert? We currently support TLS + mutual TLS on Private deployments; hosted API supports TLS + token bearer with scoped SCIM API keys. Which model do they require?

rachel_acme: We prefer mTLS for SCIM and want assertion encryption. Also need session timeout controls (idle 30m), SSO forced logout support, and a full SOC2 + penetration test report.

maria_se: For POC we can enable assertion encryption and idle session config. SOC2 report is available — I'll attach link in docs. For SCIM mTLS: if they go Dedicated or Private we can enable mTLS; hosted would use scoped provisioning tokens. Which product mode is on the table?

alex_sales: They asked for a hosted trial first, then Dedicated if perf looks good. So we need to propose two options and clear commercial triggers.

sam_security: Note: hosted SCIM tokens cannot be rotated per-customer more than once every 10s — just kidding — but serious: we support rotating tokens via API. The main thing is to document least-privilege scopes: scim.read, scim.write, scim.service-account. Also add audit log retention question — they want 12 months. Hosted has 3 months by default, enterprise add-on for 12 months.

maria_se: Ops checklist for POC: 1) Exchange SP metadata for SAML (we provide ACS + EntityID); 2) Decide initial provisioning path (S3 import vs SCIM bulk). 3) Provide sample Okta group-to-role mapping (example below). 4) Confirm deployment mode and mTLS need. 5) Pricing: 2-week Dedicated burst quote + monthly rates if they convert.

maria_se: Example mapping snippet:

```
# Okta group -> Redwood role mapping (JSON example)
{"okta_group": "acme_eng", "redwood_role": "admin"}
{"okta_group": "acme_dev", "redwood_role": "developer"}
```

alex_sales: I'll ask Rachel for SP metadata and whether they can export users CSV to S3 for the import. Also will push pricing ask: dedicated 2-week burst quote + overage rates if they go past commit.

rachel_acme: We can provide S3 access for the import. For Dedicated pricing, need a firm number to present to procurement. Also their legal wants a short note on data residency — we should confirm EU region availability.

maria_se: EU regions supported for Dedicated and Private. I'll draft a short commercial paragraph for procurement. For the pricing, do we have a standard short-term burst rate or should we do a pro-rated minimum?

sam_security: Recommend pro-rated minimum + daily burst cap. I'll coordinate with finance on numbers; for security questionnaire items I'm collecting the exact artifact links (SOC2, pen test summary, encryption standards).

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] SAML SP metadata generated: https://console.redwood.ai/p/metadata/acme-poc (expires in 7 days)

alex_sales: Great — next steps: Rachel to share SP metadata and S3 details by EOD tomorrow, we (SE + Security) to confirm SCIM approach and commercial draft within 48h. I'll update the CRM. :thumbsup:

rachel_acme: Thanks — shared SP metadata and IAM S3 role via email. We'll wait for the burst quote.

maria_se: Received SP metadata, starting Okta config doc. Will post config steps in #docs channel and ping here when ready.

sam_security: I'll attach the SOC2 link and pen test summary in the thread once I get approvals. Also documenting the mTLS requirement for Dedicated.

alex_sales: Perfect. Closing loop here — flagging possible blocker: if they insist on mTLS for hosted SCIM we need legal exception or Dedicated. Will escalate if procurement insists.

rachel_acme: Understood. We'll review options, thanks everyone. :wave:
